briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion and Google Gemini 3 escalate frontier model competition amid rising safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with multiple frontier releases this month as compute buildouts accelerate. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows around autonomous agents. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys Orion with advanced reasoning; Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus; Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B; xAI ships Grok-3; DeepSeek releases R2. Google integrates Gemini 3 across enterprise products.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New vulnerabilities surface in multi-agent frameworks. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for automotive, IoT and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramps hit volume production; Microsoft and Oracle announce 50GW data center expansions; TSMC secures new AI chip orders from multiple hyperscalers.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a closed lab or an open multi-agent ecosystem by 2028?
